interface.name: zwwm_virtual_keyboard_manager_v1
interface.description: Virtual keyboards use the compositor's current XKB keymap. They inject Linux evdev keycodes into the selected seat, with normal modifier and compositor-binding handling. Client-supplied keymaps are not used. Key injection is unavailable during session lock.

request.name: key

description.summary: press or release an evdev key

request.description: Time is a monotonic timestamp in milliseconds. Keycodes use evdev numbering; add 8 when looking up a key in the supplied XKB keymap. Modifiers are pressed/released as ordinary keys. Duplicate presses and unmatched releases are ignored. Destroying this object releases all keys held by it without releasing keys held by other devices.

event.name: keymap
event.description: Sent at creation and when the configured keymap changes. Format is wl_keyboard.keymap_format.xkb_v1. The descriptor contains a NUL-terminated XKB keymap; size includes the NUL. The receiving client owns the fd.

event.name: reset
event.description: Clear the on-screen pressed-key indicators. Sent when the seat resets or the session locks. Future presses begin a new key sequence.
